summary: Privilege escalation username and password appear once a method is chosen and can be prompted on launch; sudo needs an SSH password or key too, and credentials used in scheduled jobs must not prompt on launch; custom become plugins need Ansible 2.8+.
questions: Why does my scheduled job fail with a prompt-on-launch credential?
Can I use a sudo password without an SSH password or key?
How do I set a become password on a machine credential?
